name: Knorrhütte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Knorrhütte in Garmisch-Partenkirchen!**

Nestled at **2,052 meters** above sea level, this cozy mountain hut offers breathtaking views of the **Zugspitze**, Germany’s highest peak. Whether you're here for a hearty meal of **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Brotzeit**, or a warm **Glühwein**, the Knorrhütte is the perfect stop for hikers and nature lovers.

After a long day on the trails, relax in the rustic yet welcoming atmosphere. The hut’s traditional **Tiroler** charm, combined with modern comforts, makes it an ideal retreat. Don’t miss the chance to try local specialties like **Obatzda** or enjoy a cold **Radler** on the terrace.

Just a short hike from Garmisch-Partenkirchen’s town center, the Knorrhütte is easily accessible via the **Knorrhütte Trail** (marked as **H 10**). Whether you're seeking adventure or a peaceful escape, this alpine gem promises unforgettable moments in the heart of the **Alps**.
